<!-- Global Drag & Drop Overlay -->
<div id="globalDropOverlay" style="display:none;position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85);z-index:99999;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);">
  <div style="border:3px dashed #22c55e;border-radius:24px;padding:60px 80px;text-align:center;animation:dropPulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;background:rgba(34,197,94,0.06);">
    <div style="font-size:72px;margin-bottom:16px;">📊</div>
    <div style="font-size:26px;font-weight:800;color:#22c55e;letter-spacing:-0.5px;">Drop your chart here!</div>
    <div style="font-size:14px;color:#9ca3af;margin-top:10px;">JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP supported</div>
  </div>
</div>
<style>
@keyframes dropPulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}50%{transform:scale(1.03);opacity:0.9}}
#globalDropOverlay.active{display:flex!important}
</style>
<script>
(function(){
  const overlay = document.getElementById("globalDropOverlay");
  if(!overlay) return;
  let dragCounter = 0;
  const ALLOWED = ["image/jpeg","image/png","image/webp"];

  document.addEventListener("dragenter", function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    dragCounter++;
    if(dragCounter === 1) overlay.classList.add("active");
  });
  document.addEventListener("dragover", function(e){ e.preventDefault(); });
  document.addEventListener("dragleave", function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    dragCounter--;
    if(dragCounter <= 0){ dragCounter=0; overlay.classList.remove("active"); }
  });

  overlay.addEventListener("dragover", function(e){ e.preventDefault(); });
  overlay.addEventListener("drop", async function(e){
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
    dragCounter=0; overlay.classList.remove("active");
    const file = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
    if(!file) return;
    if(!ALLOWED.includes(file.type)){
      alert("Only JPG, PNG, WEBP images are allowed!"); return;
    }
    let _hasPlan = false;
    try{
      const res = await fetch("/check-plan");
      const data = await res.json();
      if(!data.logged_in){ alert("Please login first to use analyzer"); return; }
      // PAID user: daily limit exhausted? Block before image upload.
      if(data.has_plan && data.upload_limit > 0 && (data.upload_used || 0) >= data.upload_limit){
        var _pn = data.plan_name || data.plan || "your plan";
        alert("🚫 Daily limit reached!\n\nYour " + _pn + " plan allows " + data.upload_limit
              + " charts/day. You have used " + (data.upload_used||0) + "/" + data.upload_limit
              + " today.\n\nTry again tomorrow or upgrade your plan.");
        return;
      }
      // FREE-TRIAL user: trial exhausted? Block.
      if(!data.has_plan && !(data.is_free_trial && data.free_uploads_remaining > 0)){
        alert("Please upgrade your plan to use this feature"); return;
      }
      _hasPlan = !!data.has_plan;
    }catch(err){ /* allow if check fails */ }

    const _curPath = window.location.pathname;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(){
      sessionStorage.setItem("globalDropImage", reader.result);
      sessionStorage.setItem("globalDropName", file.name);
      sessionStorage.setItem("globalDropAutoScenario", _hasPlan ? "1" : "0");
      // Desktop home (/) — stay on same page, reload triggers pickup + auto scenario
      if(_curPath === "/" || _curPath === "/analyzer-embed"){
        window.location.reload();
      } else {
        window.location.href = "/analyzer-embed";
      }
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });

  document.addEventListener("drop", function(e){ e.preventDefault(); });
})();
</script>

<!-- ================= CHARTONIX RANKINGS / COMMUNITY FLOATING BUTTONS ================= -->
<a id="rankingsFab" href="/rankings" title="Chartonix Rankings" aria-label="Open Rankings"

<script>
// Hide floating Rankings/Community buttons on pages whose sidebar already has them
(function(){
  function hideFabsIfSidebar(){
    if(document.getElementById('rankingsSidebarBtn') || document.getElementById('communitySidebarBtn')){
      var r = document.getElementById('rankingsFab');
      var c = document.getElementById('communityFab');
      if(r) r.style.display = 'none';
      if(c) c.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }
  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', hideFabsIfSidebar);
  } else {
    hideFabsIfSidebar();
  }
})();
</script>

<!-- ================= SINGLE-DEVICE LOGIN MONITOR ================= -->
<div id="forceLogoutOverlay" style="display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85);z-index:2147483647;align-items:center;justify-content:center;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;">
  <div style="background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1f1f23,#15151a);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.35);border-radius:18px;padding:36px 42px;max-width:440px;width:90%;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 25px 70px rgba(0,0,0,0.6),0 0 0 1px rgba(239,68,68,0.15);animation:flPop 0.35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);">
    <div style="font-size:56px;margin-bottom:10px;">🔒</div>
    <div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:#fca5a5;letter-spacing:-0.3px;margin-bottom:10px;">Logged out</div>
    <div style="font-size:15px;color:#d1d5db;line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:22px;">Your account was signed in on another device.<br/>For security, only one device can be active at a time.</div>
    <button id="forceLogoutBtn" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444,#dc2626);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 28px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:0.2px;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(239,68,68,0.35);transition:transform .15s ease;">OK, Login Again</button>
  </div>
</div>
<style>
@keyframes flPop{from{transform:scale(0.85);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
#forceLogoutOverlay.active{display:flex!important}
#forceLogoutBtn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
</style>
<script>
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SINGLE-DEVICE LOGIN MONITOR  (verbose logging for debugging)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
(function(){
  console.log("[SDL] monitor script loaded, path=", window.location.pathname);

  function _init(){
    try {
      const _path = (window.location.pathname || "").toLowerCase();
      // Skip only on pure auth-entry pages (login form itself) — NOT /chartonix
      // because /chartonix serves both the login screen AND the logged-in chat UI.
      const _skip = ["/login","/signup","/register","/forgot","/reset","/logout","/referral","/creator-apply"];
      if(_skip.some(p => _path === p || _path.startsWith(p + "/"))){
        console.log("[SDL] skipped on auth page:", _path);
        return;
      }

      const fOverlay = document.getElementById("forceLogoutOverlay");
      const fBtn     = document.getElementById("forceLogoutBtn");
      if(!fOverlay || !fBtn){
        console.warn("[SDL] overlay elements missing — middleware may not have injected. Retrying in 1s...");
        setTimeout(_init, 1000);
        return;
      }
      console.log("[SDL] overlay elements found, starting polling");

      let _kicked = false;

      function _hideUserUI(){
        try {
          const _sels = [
            ".logout-bar",".user-badge",".user-name",".username",".user-chip",
            "#userName","#username","#userBadge","#user_name","#userChip",
            "#logoutBar","#logoutBtn","#logout",
            "[data-user-name]","[data-username]",".login-btn"
          ];
          _sels.forEach(function(s){
            document.querySelectorAll(s).forEach(function(el){
              el.style.setProperty("display","none","important");
              el.style.setProperty("visibility","hidden","important");
              el.style.setProperty("opacity","0","important");
            });
          });
          // Also hide Sign Out / Logout text-buttons
          document.querySelectorAll("a,button,span,div,li").forEach(function(el){
            if(el.children.length === 0){
              const _t = (el.textContent || "").trim().toLowerCase();
              if(_t === "sign out" || _t === "signout" || _t === "log out" || _t === "logout"){
                el.style.setProperty("display","none","important");
              }
            }
          });
        } catch(e) { console.error("[SDL] hideUserUI error:", e); }
      }

      function _doForceLogout(){
        if(_kicked) return;
        _kicked = true;
        console.log("[SDL] KICKED — showing logout popup");
        _hideUserUI();
        fOverlay.classList.add("active");
        fOverlay.style.setProperty("display","flex","important");
        // Keep hiding user UI — handles async re-renders
        setInterval(_hideUserUI, 500);
      }

      fBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
        // Hit /logout first to clear the stale cookie, then land on /chartonix
        fetch("/logout", {credentials:"same-origin"})
          .catch(function(){})
          .then(function(){ window.location.href = "/chartonix"; });
      });

      function _checkSession(){
        if(_kicked) return;
        fetch("/session-status?_=" + Date.now(), {
          cache:"no-store",
          credentials:"same-origin"
        })
        .then(function(r){
          if(!r.ok){ console.warn("[SDL] /session-status HTTP", r.status); return null; }
          return r.json();
        })
        .then(function(d){
          if(!d) return;
          console.log("[SDL] status:", d);
          // Kicked out: browser sent a cookie but server says token invalid
          if(d.had_cookie && !d.valid){
            _doForceLogout();
          }
        })
        .catch(function(e){ console.warn("[SDL] fetch error:", e); });
      }

      _checkSession();
      setInterval(_checkSession, 2000);

      document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function(){
        if(document.visibilityState === "visible") _checkSession();
      });
    } catch(e) {
      console.error("[SDL] init error:", e);
    }
  }

  if(document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive"){
    setTimeout(_init, 500);
  } else {
    window.addEventListener("load", function(){ setTimeout(_init, 500); });
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
